title: Senior Email and CRM Manager
description:
About the job

Senior Email and CRM Manager

Salary: $30K/annually




PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH!




About the Role

We're looking for a senior level Email and CRM Specialist to own all Klaviyo flows and campaigns across our brand portfolio. This includes ongoing lifecycle and retention email for our subscription brands, repeat purchase focused campaigns for our single purchase brand, and building out retailer facing email communication for our wholesale brand, which currently has no email program at all. You will work hands on in Klaviyo daily, and you need to already know how to build flows and campaigns independently, this is not a role where Klaviyo experience gets learned on the job.




About Us

We are a multi brand pet products company operating across subscription DTC, single purchase DTC, and wholesale models, each with different customer relationships and different email needs.




What You'll Do

Own and continuously improve Klaviyo flows for our subscription brands, including welcome series, abandoned cart, replenishment reminders, win back campaigns, and cancellation flow support

Build and manage repeat purchase focused email campaigns for our single purchase brand, including new release announcements and post purchase engagement, directly supporting a known gap in how email has been used for that brand

Build retailer facing email communication for our wholesale brand, directed at retail buyers and accounts who purchase wholesale, not end consumers, since no email program currently exists for this brand

Run ongoing A/B tests across flows and campaigns, including subject lines, send timing, content, and segmentation, and use results to continuously improve performance rather than treating any flow as finished

Optimize signup forms to maximize list acquisition, engagement, and downstream revenue

Develop content calendars aligned with each brand's objectives and release timing

Manage Klaviyo account infrastructure, integrations, and segmentation setup across all brands

Conduct regular Klaviyo audits and resolve issues involving deliverability, responsive design, dynamic tagging, and personalization

Perform quality assurance checks on every campaign and flow before send, catching rendering, link, and personalization errors before they reach customers

Monitor and analyze lifecycle and email marketing performance using Klaviyo Analytics and Google Analytics, and generate clear, accurate reporting on results

Provide data driven recommendations to improve performance and return on investment across all brands

Coordinate with each brand's manager to translate their requirements into fully built Klaviyo campaigns and flows




What We're Looking For

Minimum three years managing or heavily involved in an email retention marketing program for a B2C ecommerce brand

Hands on Klaviyo experience is required, including expert level proficiency, custom flow logic, complex segmentation, and predictive analytics features, you must already know how to independently build both flows and campaigns without ramp up time

Experience with SMS, push, or direct mail retention marketing in addition to email is a plus

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for email design and customization

Familiarity with CRM or CDP tools, ecommerce platforms such as Shopify, and Google Analytics

Required, hands on experience with a company that manufactures, ships, or fulfills a physical product to consumers

Strongly preferred, experience with a subscription or autoship product model

Strongly preferred, experience in the pet industry

Strong analytical skills with a track record of turning data into concrete revenue generating recommendations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, detail oriented, and comfortable managing multiple brands and priorities simultaneously

Self motivated and proactive, with proven success working independently in a remote environment




Work Style

Reports directly to the CEO

Supports our full brand portfolio, spanning subscription DTC, single purchase DTC, and wholesale

Fast paced, highly collaborative, and results driven environment

description:
About the job

Hey, Dingus!




Yeah, you heard that right.




Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Operator to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Operator?” Keep reading. 👀




Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.




Purpose of the Role




The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.




About You




Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
Professional level of English (written and spoken)
Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
A background in marketing is essential
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better




The Skill Requirements




You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:




Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
Newsletter writing and editing
Brand strategy and positioning
Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)




Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.




Main Objectives




1. Client Relationship Ownership

Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list




2. Hands-On Production

Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after




3. Internal Collaboration

Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here




4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.




Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

description:
About the job

Offshore SDR / Lead Generation Specialist (Recruitment) – Remote




Fully remote, full-time, US hours




A specialist recruitment firm is looking for a sales development rep to build and run its outbound engine. You'd work directly with the founder, with real ownership from week one. You will ideally have a SAAS, ERP or Tech background. But we are open to all sorts.




The role is centered on prospecting, list building and outreach campaigns that generate qualified conversations for the founder, with some marketing and candidate delivery support around it. If you're relentless about pipeline, write clean and persuasive outreach, and like seeing your work turn into booked meetings, this is built for you.




What you'd actually do




Build and clean targeted prospect lists of hiring managers and decision-makers
Research target accounts and prepare briefing notes so every outreach touch is relevant
Set up and run multi-channel outbound campaigns (email, LinkedIn) in Smartlead and our CRM
Write and test outreach sequences, subject lines and follow-ups to improve reply and meeting-booked rates
Qualify inbound and outbound leads against our ideal client profile
Book discovery calls onto the founder's calendar and hand off with full context
Track all activity and keep the CRM and pipeline data clean and current
Support marketing and candidate delivery when needed: newsletters, social posts and shortlists




You will not be closing deals or negotiating fees. That stays with the founder. Your job is to fill the top of funnel, keep the pipeline full of qualified conversations, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.




Who this suits




You've run SDR, lead gen or sales development for a company.
Your written English is genuinely excellent. This is non-negotiable, you'll be writing outreach that lands in a stranger's inbox
You know how to build a prospect list, sequence outreach and read reply-rate data
You're comfortable with outreach tools and CRMs, or you learn them fast
You like systems, lists and knowing exactly where every lead is up to
Recruitment industry exposure is a plus, not a requirement




Practical bits




Fully remote, you can be based anywhere, but you must work US business hours

Structured six-month ramp-up with training across outbound, tools and the recruitment business

Modern stack (Claude, Smartlead, and modern outreach and CRM tools), and you'll learn to use it properly

Results-focused: booked meetings and pipeline generated, not hours-logged




How to apply




Send your resume and a short note telling us why this role fits. Applicants that send a video are more likely to be selected for interview.

description:
About the job

About Omirant

Omirant Systems is creating a new category: Site Infrastructure Management (SIM) — always-on remote monitoring, diagnosis, and autonomous remediation of the physical IP infrastructure that runs multi-site operations: networks, security and access control, energy, POS, A/V, OT and other endpoints.

Physical sites became completely IP-dependent, but they're still serviced the old reactive way — a device breaks, someone eventually notices, a truck gets dispatched days later. Most of those failures are fixable remotely. We replace that model it with a 24/7, AI agent-driven NOC and a national field network for the rare times truck rolls are actually needed.




Role Description The Senior Network Engineer role is a full-time, hybrid position based in Mexico City.

You will personally run the early NOC operation — hands-on, in the weeds, doing the troubleshooting and handling documentation — and simultaneously build the machine that lets us scale it: the playbooks, agent orchestration logic, the knowledge base, and eventually the team of operators underneath you.




Day-to-day responsibilities include configuring and managing routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and other network appliances; monitoring network performance and availability; and troubleshooting complex issues across WAN, LAN, and wireless networks. The Senior Network Engineer will collaborate closely with the leadership team to build scalable monitoring standards, enhance network security controls, and create documentation and runbooks that enable rapid incident response.




Qualifications

Advanced Troubleshooting abilities: diagnosing and resolving complex network performance, connectivity, and configuration issues. Switching, routing, VLANs, DHCP/DNS, Wi-Fi, and reading a network well enough to isolate a fault remotely.
Hands-on experience with common enterprise networking technologies (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar), monitoring tools, and ticketing systems.
Real remote-access and remediation experience: SNMP (read and sensor config), SSH, VPN, and working across vendor device portals.
Direct exposure to the device classes we cover — networking plus at least a strong subset of CCTV/NVR, access control, UPS/PDU, POS, or IoT.
Genuinely comfortable in the weeds: you'd rather resolve the incident and document it than delegate it, at this stage.
The instinct to systematize — you naturally turn a one-off fix into a repeatable procedure.
Clear technical communication in Spanish and English 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP, JNCIP, or similar) are a plus.
Experience supporting and monitoring multi-site or retail environments across LATAM




Why This Role

The work compounds. Every incident you resolve becomes a documented procedure, and every procedure makes the next fix faster — for you, for the operators you'll hire, and for the AI agents that run on top of what you build. You're not maintaining someone else's legacy mess; you're setting the technical standard for a category we are building.




What we offer

An early seat with real ownership of the operating model, the knowledge base, and eventually the team — you define how it works, not just execute someone else's spec.
Competitive base compensation
Modern, AI-native tooling — you'll work with AI agents as part of the operation, shaping what they learn rather than fighting legacy systems.
Direct line to the CEO and a genuine say in how the company's core operation is built.

description:
About the job

About Neticca:

Neticca is a technology and data consulting company. We help growing companies solve engineering and data problems, and we're building out our internal team to support that work. You'll join Neticca directly, supported by our internal systems, mentorship, and Center of Excellence, with structured onboarding and long-term growth.




About the Role

We're hiring an Account & Delivery Manager to serve as the primary day-to-day liaison between our customers, our technical delivery team, and company leadership.

This is a highly customer-facing role combining relationship management, project coordination, and requirements gathering. You'll develop a strong understanding of each customer's business objectives, capture their requirements, coordinate ongoing delivery, and communicate with technical resources — helping identify where Neticca can provide additional support.

This is not a technical engineering position, but prior experience working with technology, data, IT, software, or technical implementations is strongly preferred.




Core Responsibilities

· Act as a consistent, professional point of contact for customers, leading or participating in recurring customer meetings and project discussions.

· Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and communicate project progress, dependencies, and next steps.

· Listen for new requirements and business needs, ask effective follow-up questions, and document them clearly for leadership and the technical team.

· Maintain visibility into project milestones, deliverables, and open items; track action items and escalate risks or blockers when needed.

· Coordinate communication between customers and technical resources, ensuring nothing gets lost between meetings.

· Identify potential new opportunities during customer conversations and bring them to company leadership for scoping.

· Partner with leadership on new engagements — owning discovery, requirements, and customer communication while leadership owns solution design, pricing, and contracting.




Must-Have Qualifications

· Fluent in English and Spanish, both required. English: native/primary-language level. Spanish: professional fluency — you'll work directly with Spanish-speaking engineers.

· 3–6+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Technical Account Manager, Account & Delivery Manager, Project Manager, IT Project Manager, Business Analyst, or Customer Success Manager within a technology or consulting organization.

· Comfortable working with technical concepts — data and databases, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, reporting/BI — at a conversational level, without needing to perform the technical work directly.

· Strong organizational skills and follow-through on project coordination, documentation, and action items.

· Available for scheduled customer meetings during US Eastern/Central business hours.

· Comfortable working independently with limited supervision and collaborating with distributed, international technical teams.




Nice to Have

· Prior experience in a customer-facing role at a technology consulting or professional services firm.

· Experience working directly with developers, data teams, or IT organizations.

· Track record of spotting and developing account expansion opportunities.

· Familiarity with project tools such as Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion.




Why Join Neticca?

· Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive contractor rate for top-tier talent.

· Ground-Level Impact: As a key customer-facing hire, you'll shape how we manage and grow our customer relationships.

· Career Growth: Grow with a company that invests in your development and values your expertise.

· Innovative Work Environment: Join a team that values creativity, collaboration, and cutting-edge solutions.

About the Role

Our client, a global technology company, is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to own requirements, roadmap, and backlog management for an Agile product team, as part of a newly forming Latin America delivery organization. You will act as the bridge between US-based business stakeholders, developers, and QA, ensuring that requirements are clear, current, and well understood across teams, and that each release is scoped and delivered with confidence.

Location & Work Arrangement

This is a remote-first position open to candidates based in Mexico or elsewhere in Latin America. The client is building a long-term Latin America engineering and applications presence, and these roles are foundational hires for that team. The preferred structure is contract-to-hire: an initial contract engagement of six to twelve months, followed by conversion to a permanent role for successful contributors. Direct full-time placement and longer-term independent contractor arrangements can be considered case by case. Compensation is competitive and based on seniority and skill set. Funding and headcount are approved, and start dates are immediate for candidates who are ready.

Collaboration & Communication

You will work day to day with US-based stakeholders and distributed teams in multiple regions, so fluent professional English and meaningful overlap with US business hours are required.

Own requirements management end to end: elicitation, clarification, documentation, and keeping requirements up to date.

3–5 years of solid, hands-on Business Analysis experience.

Working knowledge of Agile methodologies and Scrum.

Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication.

Nice to Have

Experience in the finance software domain.
Experience contributing to the development of AI-powered features.

You are organized, proactive, and comfortable owning outcomes. You enjoy turning ambiguity into clear, actionable requirements, and you communicate with equal ease to engineers, testers, and business stakeholders.

About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is a global company that connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. Our drivers and passengers entrust Lyft with their personal information and travel details to get where they are going and expect us to keep that data safe. Lyft's Privacy team is composed of engineers and analysts dedicated to ensuring appropriate data protections are applied to our drivers' and passengers' data. Our goal is to make privacy the default setting for our internal engineers and our customers. We help design architectures, build a scalable data platform, and define policies to reduce the exposure of user data and ensure appropriate privacy and security protections are applied across the company.

We are looking for a highly motivated, collaborative, team-focused and technically strong Senior Software Engineer to join our Privacy team. As a member of this team, you will design and build systems that make privacy the default at Lyft. Every day, you'll partner with engineering, product, legal, and compliance stakeholders on high-impact projects — from building data redaction pipelines to enabling users to exercise their privacy rights to deploying data management systems across a diverse set of Lyft services. You'll bring strong engineering instincts, a passion for privacy, and the ability to lead large projects from idea to execution.

title: Experience Management Manager
description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

You will lead the team responsible for the experience consistency of DiDi Premier, our flagship high-end product designed to redefine urban mobility through a better and reliable experience. Our mission is to curate a seamless ecosystem where every touchpoint—for both passengers and drivers—reflects a premium standard.

We are looking for an experienced operator and people leader to own the experience control system for DiDi Premier. You will define and evolve the standards that govern what Premier means in practice, run the audit programs that make compliance signals trustworthy, and own the enforcement architecture that keeps Premier's experience floor non-negotiable.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead and develop a team of analysts while staying close enough to operations to make sound calls on audit design, enforcement edge cases, and market expansion readiness. You will partner across the organization—operations, customer experience, supply, demand, and product—to ensure compliance signals translate into clear, trusted, well-applied processes across the business.

In this role, you'll be...

Own the Experience Control System: You will own the end-to-end Premier compliance architecture — the service standards governing category access, driver presentation, vehicle appearance, cancellation behavior, and service execution; the mystery shopper program that audits compliance across in-trip and out-of-trip channels; and the enforcement architecture that turns audit signals into consequences (warnings, retraining gates, suspensions, category removal, and the requalification path). You will calibrate enforcement to be firm but fair, with documented due process appropriate to each market's labor context, and revise standards based on audit outcomes, passenger feedback, and partner inputs.

Build the Cross-Functional Operating Model: You will design and operate the system through which Experience Management connects to the rest of the business — standardized weekly compliance outputs, agent-facing materials that explain enforcement decisions clearly, structured stakeholder communication cadence, and clear intake processes for cross-functional requests. Internal stakeholder satisfaction is a measurable outcome you own.

Validate Outcomes, Not Just Activity: You will close the loop between compliance metrics and real outcomes — passenger ratings, partner satisfaction, driver sentiment, and retention. When compliance improves but ratings don't, you will revise standards rather than double down on enforcement.

Lead Market Expansion Readiness: You will lead the Experience Management contribution to Premier launches in new markets — adapting standards to local context, deploying mystery shopper infrastructure, certifying local agent teams, and ensuring audit coverage thresholds are met before each market's launch date. You will travel to set up quality infrastructure on the ground.

Lead the Team and Operate with Discipline: You will manage a team of analysts across compliance and audit, driver sentiment and communications, and process governance. You will define clear scope per role, hold a weekly cadence, develop bench depth, and build a team that operates without bottlenecking through you. You will set realistic deadlines and meet them, proactively flag delays before they affect downstream stakeholders, and resolve cross-functional friction directly.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The right background: 5+ years of experience in mobility, marketplace, premium hospitality, aviation, or franchise operations, with at least 2 years of people management. You have run audit programs, mystery shopper operations, BQA-style quality systems, or equivalent enforcement functions in a high-volume operational context. Strong working proficiency in SQL or Python — you can interrogate audit and compliance data directly, design metrics that survive scrutiny, and partner credibly with data teams on signal design.

A systems mind for compliance: You think about quality control as architecture — standards, audit, enforcement, recovery, feedback loops — not as a series of one-off audits. You can articulate why compliance systems fail at scale and how to design around those failure modes. You believe that "good enough" is the enemy of "premium," and you build systems that protect that distinction at scale.

Strong people and cross-functional leadership: You scale through your team — delegating ownership rather than tasks, holding a weekly cadence, giving direct feedback, and building people who can operate without you. You believe stakeholder communication is real work, not overhead. You set clear expectations, flag risks early, and treat front-office enablement as part of the job. You're comfortable in environments where your function generates productive friction with other teams.

A bias for action in the field: You don't wait for a roadmap; you build one. You navigate ambiguity, identify the right people to influence, and drive workstreams to completion. You move fluidly between desk-based system design and on-the-ground operational work — visiting partners, observing audits in person, and traveling to support new market launches.

Cultural fluency across LATAM: You operate naturally across Mexico and the broader region, and can adapt operating models to local context without losing brand consistency. Spanish and English fluency required.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

📍Ubicación preferente: Querétaro o CDMX.




🎯 Misión del puesto:

 Brindar una atención integral y estratégica a los clientes, gestionando con empatía sus necesidades, incidencias y puntos de fricción para asegurar su satisfacción y confianza. La persona en este rol trabaja de la mano con herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial agentes conversacionales, automatizaciones y análisis asistido para responder con mayor velocidad y precisión, además de traducir cada interacción en insights que mejoren el producto y los procesos internos.

Es un puesto en evolución permanente: Las herramientas, los flujos y el alcance cambian conforme el negocio y la tecnología avanzan, por lo que la adaptabilidad y la curiosidad técnica son parte central del perfil.




🛠️ Actividades principales:

• Gestionar de manera empática situaciones con clientes que presentan inconformidades, objeciones o fricciones y dar seguimiento puntual hasta su resolución, buscando mantener la relación comercial, recuperar la confianza del cliente y asegurar una experiencia positiva alineada a los estándares de la compañía.

• Brindar atención a nuestros clientes por chat, correo o llamada, asegurándote de que se sientan apoyados y en buenas manos.

• Detectar y reportar bugs a Tech cuando identifiques errores en la plataforma.

• Compartir insights con el equipo de Producto para mejorar la experiencia del cliente.

• Colaborar en la creación de documentación y recursos de autoayuda.

• Identificar lo que el cliente realmente necesita para ofrecerle la mejor solución posible.

• Escalar y canalizar correctamente los casos que requieran apoyo de otros equipos (Tech o Revenue).

• Colaborar estrechamente con otras áreas para cumplir tiempos, entregables y reportes.

• Utilizar herramientas de IA para agilizar la resolución de incidencias, mejorar la calidad de respuestas y apoyar en el análisis de información, manteniendo criterio humano en la toma de decisiones.




📋 Requisitos:

• 1 a 2 años de experiencia en atención al cliente o soporte técnico (Ideal: Experiencia en empresa SaaS).

• Inglés básico a intermedio.

• Conocimiento o experiencia con herramientas de ticketing o soporte (Ej. Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot)




🌟 Soft Skills:

• Habilidad para explicar temas técnicos a personas no técnicas.

• Comunicación escrita y verbal excelente.

• Paciencia y empatía

• Adaptabilidad

• Capacidad de análisis y proactividad

About the job

Job Title: Customer Support & Service Coordinator (HVAC)

Location: Remote (LATAM / Central America preferred)

Compensation: $1,400–$1,600/month (Full-Time Contractor)

Hours: Full-time, Eastern Time (ET). Must be available for occasional weekends and holidays during busy seasons.

About The Company

An owner-operated HVAC and refrigeration company based in Montauk, NY. They handle high-end heating and cooling for luxury homes and well-known local businesses across the East End of Long Island. From high-efficiency systems and home automation to specialized marine refrigeration, they are known for being the most reliable team in the area.

About The Role

You will be the main point of contact for the office, acting as the bridge between our customers, our technicians, and management. You won't just be answering phones; you'll be managing the schedule in Service Titan and making sure no customer is left waiting for an update. You’ll work closely with the Office Manager and the owner to keep the daily schedule moving smoothly.

Daily Responsibilities


Scheduling & Dispatch: Pick up inbound calls and emails, log customer details in Service Titan, and get technicians dispatched to the right jobs.
Customer Follow-Ups: Call customers the day after a job is finished to make sure they’re satisfied and to give them updates on any parts we need to order.
Team Coordination: Join quick daily check-ins with the team and use a shared app to keep an eye on technician notes and job statuses.
Inbox Management: Keep the CRM portal and email inbox organized so builder and client questions are answered quickly.
Improving the Process: Help us find better ways to handle follow-up messages using basic automation or AI tools to save time.


Requirements


Experience: 2+ years in customer service, specifically for a home service company (HVAC, Plumbing, or Electrical). You need to know basic AC terms so you can talk comfortably with our customers.
The Tools: You’ve used Service Titan or a similar scheduling software before. You’re also interested in using new tools to make the office more efficient.
Language: You must speak and write English fluently. Being able to speak Spanish is a huge plus since many of our clients are bilingual.
Availability: You are comfortable working Eastern Time (ET) hours. HVAC is a seasonal business, so we need someone who can jump in on busy weekends or holidays when the weather gets extreme.
Personality: You’re organized, neat with your work, and stay calm when the phones start ringing off the hook.


Why Join the Team?


You’ll be a key part of the team, working directly with the owner to improve how we run the business.
This is a stable, long-term position with a growing company that treats its people well.
We use digital apps and simple automation to keep everyone on the same page

description:
About the job

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters:

Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem.

Your key responsibilities:
End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership.
Continuous Enablement: Develop post-onboarding curricula that keep the team sharp on new feature releases, industry trends, and advanced account management strategies ; including expansion positioning from upselling and cross-selling

Blended Learning Delivery: Develop and deliver engaging learning experiences—including live workshops, virtual sessions, and eLearning—for global CS teams of all experience levels.

Tools & Stack Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for the CS toolset (Gong, Salesforce andPlanhat,ensuring the team navigates our systems with speed and precision.
Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with CS Leadership to drive accountability and partner with Sales Enablement to ensure cohesive product and process updates across the revenue org.
Advocacy & Improvement: Serve as a trusted advisor and champion for continuous improvement in CS skills, processes, and training best practices.

 

What you’ll bring:

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science. 

Required:

CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus.
The "CS Lens" on Sales Process: A solid understanding of the B2B lifecycle. You understand how discovery, handoffs, and pipeline management directly impact long-term retention and expansion.

Instructional Design Mastery: Experience creating clean, professional training materials, slide decks, and tutorials. Proficiency in Articulate (or similar authoring tools) is required to build our eLearning library.

Experience we consider a plus:

Cross-Functional Collaborator: Ability to work effectively with Sales/CS Ops, Product Marketing, and CS Managers to ensure content is technically accurate and relevant to the field.
Detail-Oriented & Precise: A passion for accuracy and a "get it right" mindset when documenting internal processes and system workflows.
Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them.
Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.
Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 

 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Field Marketing Manager

The Field Marketing Manager will manage demand generation efforts in Mexico, and build a robust marketing pipeline across a number of channels, including events, digital and partnerships. This role will report directly to our VP of Marketing, LatAm. The ideal candidate is an effective leader with proven management skills and proven experience leading acquisition efforts. You are data-driven and have a proven ability to develop, track and scale new marketing initiatives across all channels. This is a highly matrixed role collaborating across the LatAm and Global Marketing teams to deliver efficient acquisition strategy and tactics.

What You’ll Do


Design and manage our acquisition marketing strategy in Mexico to ensure that objectives are met to maximum efficiency.

Optimize our ROI and budget to reach our targets. Work on increasing our Lead quality and conversion rate. Find new, innovative ways to increase lead generation.

8+ years of proven experience in marketing.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. description:
About the job

Location: Mexico City

Reports to: CEO

Scope: SARELLY Mexico, with potential broader regional responsibilities over time




MISSION

Make SARELLY the strongest and most innovative beauty brand online in Mexico.

The Online Sales Director will lead SARELLY’s entire digital commercial ecosystem — from DTC and marketplaces to social commerce and the e-commerce performance of our retail partners.

This is not a channel-management role. It is a growth leadership role.

You will be responsible for defining where the next wave of digital growth will come from, building the strategy to capture it, and mobilizing Commercial, Marketing, Content, Community, Operations and Data around it.

Because digital is often where new consumer behaviors, products and commercial models emerge first, this role is also designed as a potential stepping stone toward broader Mexico General Management responsibilities.




ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is a fast-growing, entertainment-native beauty brand born in Mexico, building the next generation of beauty for a global audience.

Founded by creator and entrepreneur Anna Sarelly, SARELLY sits at the intersection of beauty, entertainment, community and commerce. We don't just launch products — we create cultural moments around them, combining product innovation, creator-led storytelling and a highly engaged community.

Since launching beauty in 2023, SARELLY has rapidly expanded from DTC into social commerce, marketplaces and physical retail. Today, the brand is present at leading beauty retailers including Sephora and Ulta in Mexico and is entering its next phase of international growth, including a major U.S. retail expansion.

Digital has been part of SARELLY's DNA from day one. Our products have become best sellers on platforms including TikTok Shop, while our entertainment and creator ecosystem gives us a unique ability to turn cultural relevance into commercial performance.

As we enter our next stage, we want to build one of the most innovative digital commerce engines in beauty in Mexico — and are looking for a leader who can help us define what that looks like.




1. OWN THE ONLINE BUSINESS

Own the strategy, commercial performance and P&L across SARELLY’s digital channels in Mexico:

SARELLY.com
Mercado Libre
Amazon
TikTok Shop
Emerging marketplaces and social-commerce channels
E-commerce business of key retail partners, including Sephora and Ulta

Build one integrated digital commercial strategy while defining the distinct role, consumer mission and economics of each channel.

Own revenue, profitability, traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat purchase, assortment and promotional strategy.

Set ambitious annual and quarterly targets and translate them into clear commercial plans and priorities.




2. CREATE THE NEXT GROWTH ENGINES

Don't just execute an existing playbook — create the next one.

Continuously identify, test and scale new opportunities across:

Platforms and emerging channels
Commercial models
Assortments, bundles and exclusives
Launch and promotional mechanics
Affiliate and creator-commerce programs
Live-shopping formats
CRM and retention initiatives
Partnerships and technology

Stay ahead of shifts in consumer behavior, platform capabilities and commerce innovation, turning successful experiments into scalable and profitable businesses.




3. MAKE SARELLY A DIGITAL COMMERCE CASE STUDY

Our ambition is for SARELLY to become a reference for how the next generation of beauty brands wins online.

The question should constantly be:

“What can SARELLY do online that other beauty brands are not doing yet?”

Partner closely with Marketing, Content, Community and Creator teams to develop commercial ideas that are culturally relevant, entertaining and native to each platform.

Use SARELLY’s entertainment and community ecosystem as a competitive advantage, connecting content, creators and commerce rather than treating e-commerce as simply the final transactional step of a marketing funnel.

Build ideas and capabilities in Mexico that can ultimately inspire SARELLY's approach in other markets.




4. TURN SOCIAL COMMERCE INTO A CORE CAPABILITY

Make TikTok Shop and emerging social-commerce channels major engines for both revenue and customer acquisition.

Define and continuously optimize the right combination of:

Organic content
Affiliate creators
Paid amplification
Live commerce
Product seeding
Promotions
Exclusive drops
Hero-SKU strategies

Work hand in hand with Marketing and Community so commercial insights influence content decisions — and content insights translate into commercial opportunities.

Build a repeatable social-commerce model that can scale with the brand.




5. WIN ON MARKETPLACES

Build differentiated strategies for Mercado Libre and Amazon, recognizing them as strategic businesses rather than secondary distribution channels.

Own and optimize:

Assortment and pricing architecture
Product pages and digital content
Search visibility
Retail media
Promotions
Ratings and reviews
Inventory availability
Conversion
Marketplace-specific launches and activations

Understand the different consumer missions and economics of each marketplace and adapt SARELLY’s approach accordingly.

Develop strong relationships with platform teams and position SARELLY as a priority and innovative beauty partner.




6. WIN ON OUR RETAILERS' DIGITAL SHELVES

Make SARELLY as powerful online within our retail partners as it is in their physical stores.

Partner with the Wholesale team to lead the digital growth agenda at retailers such as Sephora and Ulta, bringing dedicated e-commerce expertise while Wholesale remains the owner of the overall retailer relationship.

Drive excellence across:

Digital assortment and availability
Product pages and content
Search and discoverability
Ratings and reviews
Retail media
Digital launches and promotions
CRM opportunities
Retailer-specific activations

Develop joint digital growth plans with strategic retailers and make their e-commerce businesses meaningful growth engines for SARELLY.




7. CONNECT MARKETING, CULTURE AND COMMERCE

Act as a key commercial partner to the Mexico Marketing team, translating consumer, content and platform signals into growth opportunities.

Bring proactive ideas, not just briefs:

“We are seeing this behavior on TikTok — what should we launch around it?”

“This product is accelerating on Mercado Libre — how do we amplify it?”

“This creator mechanic is converting — how do we scale it?”

“This retailer has an untapped digital opportunity — what can we propose?”

Constantly connect what consumers are watching, talking about and searching for with what they ultimately buy.




8. BUILD THE OPERATING MODEL TO SCALE

Create the data, dashboards and commercial rituals required to make faster and better decisions.

Build a clear view across channels of:

Net sales and growth
Gross and contribution margin
Traffic and conversion
AOV
CAC / ROAS where relevant
New vs. repeat customers
Sell-through
Inventory and OOS
Search performance
Affiliate performance
Content-to-commerce conversion
Retail media performance

Build a culture that goes beyond reporting what happened to understanding why it happened, what we learned and what we should do next.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 12–24 months:

SARELLY has built a significantly larger, more diversified and more profitable online business.

TikTok Shop, Mercado Libre and Amazon have become major growth engines, while SARELLY.com has evolved into an increasingly sophisticated platform for acquisition, conversion and retention.

SARELLY is consistently one of the strongest-performing beauty brands online within its strategic retail partners.

The company has developed distinctive capabilities around entertainment-driven, creator-driven and social commerce, with successful ideas continuously tested, measured and scaled.

Most importantly, platforms, retailers and the beauty industry increasingly recognize SARELLY as a case study for how the next generation of beauty brands wins online in Mexico.




THE PROFILE

We are looking for a builder, not a channel administrator.

Someone commercially ambitious, digitally native and highly analytical — but equally capable of generating ideas, taking calculated risks and challenging how things have traditionally been done.

Ideally, this person has:

Significant e-commerce and marketplace experience in Mexico
Proven ownership of meaningful online revenue and P&L
Strong experience with Amazon and/or Mercado Libre
Hands-on understanding of TikTok Shop, social commerce or creator-led commerce
Experience working with major retailers' e-commerce businesses
Strong commercial and analytical capabilities
Solid understanding of digital marketing and retail media
Experience managing teams and external partners
The ability to influence and operate cross-functionally across Marketing, Content, Operations and Finance
An entrepreneurial mindset and appetite to build, experiment and move fast

Beauty experience is valuable, but digital commercial excellence, leadership potential and entrepreneurial mindset matter more than category pedigree.




LEADERSHIP EXPECTATION

This role is designed for someone with the ambition and potential to grow beyond e-commerce.

Digital is often where SARELLY sees consumer trends first, tests new ideas first and learns fastest. That makes this position a unique vantage point into the broader Mexico business.

For the right leader, the scope could progressively evolve from:

Online Sales Director

→ broader Commercial leadership

→ potential General Manager Mexico

To make that progression possible, we expect this person to think beyond their immediate channels from day one — developing a strong understanding of the consumer, brand, wholesale, physical retail, operations, profitability and overall performance of SARELLY Mexico.

The ultimate expectation is not simply to run online sales.

It is to help build the future commercial model of SARELLY.

Glia is the #1 Banking AI platform, empowering community and regional financial institutions to create efficiencies, accelerate loan growth, drive deposits, and deliver experiences that win against megabanks and fintechs.

Glia's Banking AI Operating System is a central intelligence layer on top of existing tech stacks, activating an AI workforce of specialized agents that draw from banking data, interaction history, and integrated systems of record. Trusted by 700+ banks and credit unions for its ironclad security and reliability, Glia delivers the industry’s first contractual no-hallucination guarantee. At Glia, we believe banking is personal—and our marketing should be too. As the Experiential Marketing Coordinator, you will play a key supporting role in bringing our experiential strategy to life. You will support the planning and execution of high-impact marketing experiences—spanning in-person events like executive summits, conferences, and event activations, as well as highly engaging virtual experiences such as webinars and interactive virtual round tables—all designed to deepen relationships and build pipeline within our defined Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

Workflow Automation & AI Efficiency: Identify opportunities to streamline manual event tasks by leveraging AI tools and automated workflows.


Who You Are

Detail-Oriented & Organized: Exceptional project management and organizational skills with a strong eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple event timelines simultaneously.

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we’re a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We’re hiring an Email Marketing Strategist (Klaviyo) to own the lifecycle messaging engine for a fast-growing direct-to-consumer cookware and home goods brand heading into its biggest selling season of the year. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy engagement — you’ll audit and optimize the existing Klaviyo flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment), build new automations to close the gaps in the customer lifecycle, and run a disciplined testing program across subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic. You’ll also own the weekly SMS calendar and make sure email and SMS work as one coordinated journey rather than two channels competing for the same inbox. The through-line is holiday readiness: building an August–December testing and optimization roadmap, fixing automation gaps before peak traffic hits, tuning segmentation and cadence to lift repeat purchase rate, and flagging risks like deliverability issues, list fatigue, or flow bottlenecks with enough lead time to actually fix them before Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday shipping deadlines. A strong fit if you’re the kind of marketer who QAs every send twice, reads statistical significance properly, and would rather ship five well-documented tests than one big untested swing.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

1) Email Automation & Flow Optimization: Audit, maintain, and optimize existing email automations and flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment — and build new automations to fill gaps in the customer lifecycle.

Flow Branching & Segmentation Logic: Design, build, and maintain complex, multi-branch Klaviyo flows utilizing conditional splits, profile filters, and delay logic to ensure highly personalized, non-fatiguing user journeys.
Trigger Mechanics Management: Configure and troubleshoot event-based triggers and profile filters piped from Shopify to Klaviyo (e.g., Active on Site, Viewed Product, Added to Cart). Ensure custom properties and behavioral attributes are mapped perfectly to trigger appropriate sequences without overlap.




2) Testing & Experimentation: Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic/triggers, then recommend and prioritize a testing backlog based on expected impact.




3) QA & Deliverability: QA every flow for deliverability, rendering, links, personalization, and segmentation accuracy before and during peak season, and monitor flow performance to make data-driven adjustments in real time.




4) SMS Program Management: Develop and run SMS tests across messaging, timing, frequency, and offers; own and manage the weekly SMS sending schedule and calendar; and keep SMS and email coordinated rather than conflicting or redundant across the customer journey.




5) Holiday Readiness & Revenue Goals: Build a holiday-specific testing and optimization roadmap for August–December, proactively identify and fix automation gaps before peak traffic hits, and adjust segmentation, targeting, and messaging cadence to support repeat purchase rate and overall revenue goals.




6) Risk Flagging: Surface deliverability issues, list fatigue, and flow bottlenecks with enough lead time to fix them before key selling periods such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday shipping deadlines.




7) Reporting & Collaboration: Report weekly on test results, flow performance, and SMS program metrics, and partner with creative/design and merchandising teams to keep content and offers aligned with the promotional calendar.

Deep Analytical Lookback Audits: Leverage Looker, Omni, and Klaviyo data to conduct deep-dive, lookback audits — going beyond basic reporting on delivered, open, click, or unsubscribe rates to investigate the “why” behind flow performance changes, actively identifying customer drop-off bottlenecks in abandonment and post-purchase series.




What You Bring

Email Automation Expertise: Proven experience managing email marketing automation in Klaviyo or a similar ESP, with hands-on ownership of lifecycle flows end to end.
Hands-on Klaviyo Architecture: 3+ years of active, hands-on experience building custom segment triggers, conditional splits, and managing multi-path flow logic within Klaviyo (experience with raw HTML/CSS templates preferred).
SMS Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Klaviyo SMS, Attentive, or Postscript.
Testing & Analytics: A strong understanding of A/B testing methodology and how to read statistical significance, plus an analytical mindset that’s comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data to guide decisions.
Data-Driven Root-Cause Vetting: Strong analytical skills with a proven track record of using BI tools (like Looker or Omni) to perform root-cause analysis on customer journey drop-offs, and comfortable explaining how to diagnose flow underperformance beyond surface-level dashboards.
Segmentation & Lifecycle Strategy: Experience with segmentation strategy and lifecycle marketing, and familiarity with repeat rate, LTV, and revenue-per-recipient as success metrics.
Independent Execution: Comfort working independently in a deadline-driven environment, especially during high-volume holiday periods.
Autonomous Strategic Sourcing: Strong consultative confidence — ability to take a marketing brief, analyze targeting requirements, proactively identify list-fatigue or deliverability risks, and propose alternative testing ideas.
Written Communication: Excellent written communication skills — this is email and SMS copy, after all.




Bonus Points if:

E-commerce/DTC background
Experience with Shopify or similar platforms
Prior experience specifically prepping brands for Q4/holiday peak

Descripción de la empresa 




VoiSek es una empresa especializada en la inteligencia contra las estafas y en su prevención para los sectores industriales más exigentes. Trabajamos a tiempo completo en el diseño y mejora de soluciones que ayuden a personas y empresas a mantenerse siempre un paso por delante de quienes intentan cometer fraudes. Nos centramos en la protección de comunicaciones, la seguridad de datos y la prevención de riesgos asociados al uso del teléfono. Buscamos talento que quiera crecer en un entorno digital dinámico y orientado a la seguridad.




¿A quién buscamos?




A un ingeniero o ingeniera DevOps con máximo 5 años de experiencia. Buscamos talento que quiera integrarse a un equipo con una cultura de mejora continua para aportar y aprender el modo VoiSek. 




Descripción del puesto 




Como Ingeniero/a DevOps en VoiSek, participarás en el diseño, implementación y mantenimiento de la infraestructura que soporta nuestras soluciones de protección telefónica. En tu día a día automatizarás despliegues, gestionarás pipelines de integración y entrega continua, supervisarás el rendimiento de sistemas y colaborarás estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo y seguridad para mejorar nuestras plataformas. También te encargarás de optimizar el uso de recursos en la nube, mantener entornos seguros y actualizados, y documentar buenas prácticas y procesos. Y acompañaras a clientes y a equipos internos en diversos procesos de nuestra cadena de valor para la entrega de nuestros servicios altamente especializados. 




Este es un puesto de tiempo completo en modalidad híbrido, ubicado en México, con uno o dos días de home-office a la semana. 




Requisitos




Que te comuniques bien, claramente, asertivamente y sin miedo. 
Que sepas hablar inglés y español profesionalmente. 
Que te guste proponer y actuar. Necesitamos talento que sepa pensar y que sepa hacer. 
Que te gusten los retos y el desarrollo y cumplimiento de mejores prácticas. 




Además, claro:




Experiencia sólida en diseño, implementación y operación de arquitecturas cloud.
Dominio de Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD y automatización. 
Conocimiento de seguridad cloud.
Experiencia en monitoreo, troubleshooting, optimización de performance y costos, así como en backup, disaster recovery y continuidad de negocio. 
Capacidad para brindar soporte técnico a clientes y colaborar con equipos de Engineering, Operations y Security.

Competencias y perfil que buscamos




Pensamiento estratégico combinado con fuerte capacidad de ejecución.

Asertividad y habilidades de comunicación e influencia (traducir lo técnico a lo accionable). 
Alto sentido de ownership y proactividad. 
Orientación a resultados y capacidad de priorización. 
Resiliencia y comodidad en entornos dinámicos y de alta exigencia. 
Mentalidad de crecimiento: alguien que busca un espacio con mayor alcance e impacto para desarrollar su potencial.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




Lealtad, honestidad, respeto y pragmatismo. Trabajar en VoiSek es pertenecer a un equipo joven, retador, líder e internacional, gozando de un paquete muy competitivo de compensaciones que te ofrece libertad para organizar un muy buen estilo de vida. En VoiSek, nos va bien a todos.




¿Cómo es el proceso?




Primero hablarás con el CEO. Si todo bien, hablarás con los principales líderes del equipo, si todo bien, hablarás con la CFO, y recibirás una oferta. Si te gusta, estás dentro en septiembre 2026 con un contrato indefinido, con tres meses gozando de todos los beneficios pero entendiendo que si algo no funciona para alguna de las partes, sin "hard feelings" partimos camino, y si todo bien, a crecer juntos hasta donde tope.




Envía tu CV a jobs@voisek.com y por favor asegúrate de enviar claramente tu email y tu número de contacto WhatsApp pues recibirás respuesta en máximo 48 horas. Te sugerimos prepararte bien para las sesiones de conocimiento y descubrimiento. Es clave.

Location: Remote (Mexico / Latin America) with monthly onsite presence in Mexico City

Employment Type: Contract-to-hire (6–12 months, then conversion); direct hire considered

About the Role

Our client, a global technology company serving a consumer base of more than 100 million customers, is seeking a Senior Salesforce Administrator to own and evolve a business-critical Salesforce environment, with a strong emphasis on Revenue Cloud (RCA) and CPQ. This is one of the client's two most critical hires for its new Latin America team. You will translate needs from Sales, Finance, Support, and IT into well-designed declarative solutions, keep the platform performant and secure in a high-volume operating environment, and help shape how the organization adopts AI capabilities such as Agentforce and AI voice agents.

Location & Work Arrangement

This is a remote-first position open to candidates based in Mexico or elsewhere in Latin America. Candidates must be able to work onsite in Mexico City at least once per month, and to attend quarterly in-person team events there. Candidates based in Mexico (Mexico City preferred) are prioritized for roles on the full-time conversion track; candidates elsewhere in Latin America are welcome for contract engagements. Legal authorization to work in the country of residence is required.

Engagement Model

The client is building a long-term Latin America engineering and applications presence, and these roles are foundational hires for that team. The preferred structure is contract-to-hire: an initial contract engagement of six to twelve months, followed by conversion to a permanent role for successful contributors. Direct full-time placement and longer-term independent contractor arrangements can be considered case by case. Compensation is competitive and based on seniority and skill set. Funding and headcount are approved, and start dates are immediate for candidates who are ready.

Collaboration & Communication

You will work day to day with US-based stakeholders and distributed teams in multiple regions, so fluent professional English and meaningful overlap with US business hours are required.

Key Responsibilities

Administer and maintain the Salesforce environment, including user setup, profiles, roles, permissions, and data integrity.
Build and optimize Salesforce Flows, validation rules, formulas, and approval processes.
Manage and configure Salesforce RCA/CPQ, including product bundles, pricing rules, quote templates, and guided selling.
Partner with support and operations teams in a high-pressure, high-volume environment, treating internal users as customers and keeping business-critical processes running smoothly.
Evaluate, pilot, and support AI-driven Salesforce capabilities, including Agentforce and AI voice agents, as the organization adopts them.
Translate business requirements into technical solutions using platform best practices.
Work with cross-functional teams (Sales, Finance, IT, etc.) to support CRM processes and enhancements.
Conduct impact analysis for new features and integrations.
Support data migrations, imports, and exports using tools such as Data Loader.
Support system integration initiatives, including testing and user adoption.
Monitor system performance and proactively address issues or inefficiencies.
Document configurations, customizations, and processes.

Required Qualifications

6–8 years of hands-on Salesforce Administration experience.
Proficiency in Salesforce RCA and CPQ configuration, quoting processes, and customizations.
Demonstrated collaborative, service-oriented mindset; comfortable supporting a large, fast-moving operation where platform issues have immediate business impact.
Strong experience with Flow Builder, formulas, validation rules, and declarative automation tools.
Ability to read, interpret, and translate business requirements into Salesforce configurations.
Excellent understanding of Salesforce best practices and platform limitations.

Nice to Have

Hands-on exposure to Agentforce and/or AI voice agents (strong plus).

Experience administering Salesforce for a large-scale B2C or subscription business.

What We Look For

You bring strong attention to detail and organizational skills, are self-driven, and manage your time effectively while working independently. You are comfortable in a remote, collaborative, cross-cultural environment.

description:
About the job

About US




We are a growing specialty healthcare practice dedicated exclusively to the care of patients who have lost an eye. We work closely with ophthalmologists, oculoplastic surgeons, hospitals, and patients to provide custom ocular prostheses (artificial eyes) with exceptional compassion and clinical care.




As we continue to grow, we're looking for a friendly, professional, and highly organized Patient Care Coordinator to become the first point of contact for our patients. This role is essential in ensuring every patient receives outstanding service from their very first interaction with our practice.




About the Role

As our Patient Care Coordinator (remote), you'll play a critical role in creating an outstanding patient experience. You'll answer inbound calls, schedule appointments, verify insurance benefits, and support our office staff across our Utah and Kansas offices.




This is a patient-facing administrative position requiring exceptional communication skills, attention to detail, and a genuine desire to help others.




Responsibilities

1. Patient Communication

Answer inbound calls professionally and courteously
Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments
Return voicemail messages promptly
Answer general patient questions
Route calls to the appropriate team member when necessary
Deliver a compassionate, 5-star patient experience




2. Scheduling & Patient Support

Confirm upcoming appointments
Contact patients regarding annual follow-up visits
Fill cancelled appointment openings
Update patient demographic and insurance information
Coordinate schedules with our clinical team




3. Health Insurance Verification

Verify health insurance eligibility and benefits
Contact insurance companies regarding patient coverage
Obtain prior authorizations when needed
Document benefit information accurately
Assist with insurance claim follow-up




4. Administrative Support

Maintain accurate patient records
Update internal tracking spreadsheets
Support our Practice Coordinator with administrative tasks
Communicate with the team throughout the day using Microsoft Teams
